goals: Preserve the user-confirmed Matcha × Trinkets visual compatibility scope so Trinkets inventory elements belong visually to Matcha Flavoured without changing logical slot behavior.
Keep the visual layer dependent on the accepted Trinkets × Inventory Extended coordinate and layout contract instead of creating a second slot-layout model.
scope: Style Trinkets slot frames, group backgrounds, empty-slot icons, attached slot artwork, hover and highlight presentation, and Creative → Survival presentation where applicable.
Support dynamically contributed Trinkets groups and slots where practical rather than limiting presentation to the historically installed belt, charm, and necklace examples.

Preserve the frozen user decision that the approved visual and resource-pack scope is complete while recording that no project-owned implementation, release, or runtime matrix survives in the legacy project path.

exclusions: Changes to Trinkets slot IDs or ownership, menu indices, player inventory size, quick-move behavior, equip rules, Inventory Extended slot mapping, or server-side inventory behavior.
A new Trinkets API port, visual redesign, new implementation, or behavior change during this preservation migration.
Trinkets, Inventory Extended, Matcha Flavoured, the Trinkets × Inventory Extended compatibility layer, and artifacts or resources owned by those independent projects.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, Test Slot A or B mutation, accepted-baseline changes, promotion, or protected gameplay-instance access during this migration.

dependencies.reason: Exact game target of the preserved visual scope.
Exact frozen Matcha Flavoured dependency evidence for the completed visual scope; the archive remains independently owned and is not imported.
Exact frozen Matcha × Inventory Extended composition dependency; the pack remains independently owned and is not imported.
Exact frozen accepted Trinkets client/layout dependency whose API, production behavior, and patched artifact remain independently owned.
Exact frozen accepted six-row inventory/layout dependency whose mapping and patched artifact remain independently owned.
The visual scope consumes the independently owned accepted wrapper, slot-frame, group-background, empty-icon, and item-render coordinates instead of reimplementing them.

state.milestone: The user confirmed the approved visual compatibility scope complete; no additional runtime result is inferred, and the frozen legacy project contains no project-owned implementation, release, or project-specific runtime pass.
